blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) has issued proper pay guidelines to employers for the 13th-month pay to their employees. Labor Secretary Francis N. Tolentino on Monday signed Labor Advisory No. 21, Series of 2026, setting guidelines for paying 13th-month pay under Article 5 of the Labor Code of the Philippines and Presidential Decree No. 851. Under the guidelines, rank-and-file employees in the private sector are entitled to 13th-month pay regardless of their employment status, position or method of wage payment, provided they have worked for at least one month during the calendar year. “It also should be […]...
